about_the_game:
Is it a bird? A plane?! It’s a bird. A really, really cute one though.

Immortalize the chunkiest, cutest birds you’ve ever seen with Birdseed’s in-game camera, meant to feel just like you’re holding the real thing. Aim, shoot, print and record the birds you’ve found in your Journal and work on getting that perfect 3 star shot! Binoculars help you zero in on your subject and plan the right lens for the shot - just like a real birdwatcher.

Get cozy and enjoy the immersive sounds of the forest around you.

The birds and bird sounds of Birdseed are all based on their real life counterparts. Step into a cozy forest setting and let the nature sounds wrap you up in a warm hug!

Bird watching is better spent with some friends!

Wish you could share that perfect shot with your friends? The social multiplayer in Birdseed is designed for maximum coziness - share photos, track your best scores, and chat while you enjoy the simple act of birdwatching together.

Features:

  • Cozy social multiplayer - play online with a friend, share photos, and enjoy nature together

  • Take on daily quests - check your Journal every day for new missions to embark on

  • Get the perfect shot - track your shots in your Journal and aim for higher star ratings

  • Immerse yourself in nature - enjoy spatial audio design that transports you into the forest, with unique bird calls for each bird you spot

  • Suitable for seated play - even this VR experience is cozy! No need to move around - get the perfect shot even from the comfort of your couch

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660, AMD RX 580, or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, Windows MR, HP Reverb, HTC VIve, Index

short_description: Snap pics of the chunkiest, cutest birds in VR! Relax in lush forests, complete quirky daily quests, and fill your Journal. Whether you’re birding alone or together with friends, get cozy and escape to nature.
